facts.fact: 章首：她指挥 Lucas 磨姜粉备料——仪式开场
facts.anchor: “Finer,” Andra ordered over Lucas’s shoulder. “The ginger needs to be a powder, not a crumble.”

facts.fact: 多年只用元素做小事怕召暗兽（毒牙男袭击夜）；火焰柱失控首演
facts.anchor: summoning more power would call a dark creature to their village, like the night the fanged man attacked.

facts.fact: 控火失控：火柱竖起 Lucas 惊滚——元素不可预测
facts.anchor: a surge of power shot down her arms and into the fire, creating a tall pillar of flames between her and Lucas.

facts.fact: 仪式材料：鼠尾草+两人头发+泥上符文；Lucas 抱怨拔头发"才三根"
facts.anchor: “Was it really necessary to rip my hair out?

facts.fact: Lucas 问"你确定吗"后举匕首宣誓"我跟你一起，Cousin"——如旱后夏雨
facts.anchor: Lucas closed his eyes for a moment and inhaled. Slowly, he raised the dagger by the blade in an offering.

facts.fact: 割掌：血浸鼠尾草/两人头发/符文；咒文 Enface delamor elpevu sermon 反复念
facts.anchor: Andra aligned the blade with her palm and cut straight across, deep enough for blood to pool there.

facts.fact: 符文金光震颤——咒语贪得无厌吸血至眼前发黑，Lucas 喝止后爆炸掀翻两人
facts.anchor: fueling the thirsty spell that insisted on taking more than Andra could give

facts.fact: 爆炸把两人掀翻；他撕衣摆为她包扎掌心
facts.anchor: Magic shot down her arms in an explosion of color, sending both herself and Lucas backward onto the earth.

facts.fact: 代价：肩背浮现细小金斑——光滑如雀斑不刻不凸，疼痛全消
facts.anchor: Starting on her shoulder and trickling onto her upper back were a smattering of tiny, golden spots etched into her skin.

facts.fact: 匪徒押昏迷俘虏到场却看不见火——结界隐匿生效；俘虏喊 Snavellers 被踩晕
facts.anchor: Two men emerged, their clothes worn and dirty with rusty weapons strapped to their bodies.

facts.fact: 猎人循血味进圈：摘兜帽、嗅空气、黑瞳闪金光——她竟想前倾触碰
facts.anchor: It was him. Her stranger from the Southern Woods.

facts.fact: 尾声拍板：我们去客栈（隐匿经验决定行止）
facts.anchor: “We’ll go to the inn,” she whispered.
